purpose: Canonical class-skill rules, skill IDs, level scaling, and monster-family impact for all 35 jobs.

skill_rules.point_award: 1 Skill Point every 5 character levels plus 3 bonus points when reaching Tier 2, Tier 3, Tier 4, and Tier 5.
skill_rules.use_rule: All 8 class skills are available at base level 1. Extra Skill Points raise individual skill levels to a maximum of 10.
skill_rules.level_scaling: Each skill level above 1 adds 8% to that skill's damage/support scalar.
skill_rules.reset_rule: At Tier 5 (Lv.200+) the player may reset class skill levels back to 1 and recover every point previously spent above level 1. Reset also clears skill cooldowns.
